title: Althaïr Exclusif Travel Duo
body: Discover the new Althaïr Exclusif, now available in a travel-ready duo. This set pairs your chosen size with a 10ml travel spray, ensuring your signature scent accompanies you on every adventure.

title: Delina Coffret
body:
For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Delina gift set.

Addictive, sensual and generous, Delina opens with a vibrant, sweet and juicy lychee, unfolding into a Damascena rose heart and a trail of soft musks and cashmeran. This gift set contains the most intimate perfumed ritual with a 75ml Delina Eau de parfum, a 75ml Delina hair perfume and a 200ml Delina refillable body cream.

title: Althaïr Coffret
body:
For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Althaïr gift set.

Elegant, generous, and charismatic, Althaïr blends the sweetness of vanilla, the indulgence of praline, and the radiance of orange blossom. This set includes Althaïr Eau de Parfum 125ml and two 10ml travel sizes.

title: Valaya Coffret
body:
For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Valaya gift set.

Elegant, delicate and sensual, Valaya evokes cotton caressing the skin with crisp mandarin, creamy white flowers, and rich akigalawood, melting into a trail of musks. This gift set contains the most refined perfumed ritual with a 75ml Valaya Eau de parfum, a 75ml Valaya hair perfume and a 200ml Valaya refillable body cream.

title: Delina Exclusif Coffret
body:
For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Delina Exclusif gift set.

Mysterious, intense and seductive, Delina Exclusif unveils fruity lychee and pear, melting into a sensual heart of Damascena rose and vetiver, wrapped in soft musks and warm vanilla. title: Countdown Calendar
body:
For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine in the 18th century. Drifting between snow-kissed gardens and constellations, the Maison celebrates a dreamlike voyage where history and wonder come together beyond the stars

True to the tradition of the Sun King, who was known for offering precious gifts to celebrate the New Year, this Countdown Calendar composed of 12 gifts across 7 drawers, unveils an enchanting world where each discovery becomes a moment of wonder on this journey beyond the stars.

title: Valaya Body Cream Refill
body:
The Valaya body cream refill fits inside your original jar for a sustainable approach. Leaving the skin scented with the elegant notes of Valaya, its minimalist formula of carefully selected ingredients delicately moisturizes the skin for 8 hours*.

Massage the cream onto your body as part of your daily ritual. 

*Instrumental test on 11 women.

title: Althaïr Exclusif
body: Althair Exclusif composes an olfactory sonata built around an intense Bourbon vanilla, elevated by the velvety nuances of amaretto and the warm radiance of saffron. Addictive, refined and captivating.

title: The Discovery Trio
body: Curate your own olfactory journey with the Discovery Trio: three 10ml travel sprays, selected from our iconic feminine and masculine fragrances. Presented in an elegant travel pouch, this trio is the perfect way to carry your signature scents wherever you go.

title: Les Extraits Discovery Set
body: Discover Les Extraits Collection by Parfums de Marly with the Les Extraits Discovery Set, featuring Carios, Eragon and Valero in a 5ml format. Three olfactory masterpieces where exceptional raw materials and creative audacity unite to reveal the essence of ultimate luxury and the legacy of unparalleled French savoir-faire.

title: Pegasus Exclusif
body: Pegasus Exclusif opens with vibrant accents of pink pepper, unfolds into the delicate smoothness of almond, then deepens into a woody trail of oud and vanilla. Powerful, charismatic and assertive.

title: Herod
body: Herod opens with the spicy intensity of cinnamon, evolves into a deep heart of tobacco leaves, then settles into a warm vanilla base. Prestigious, gourmand and opulent.

title: Palatine
body: Palatine pays tribute to a daring contemporary violet, with luminous and powdery notes. Dazzling, audacious and sophisticated.

title: Valaya Refillable Body Cream
body:
The Valaya body cream leaves the skin scented with the elegant notes of the Valaya fragrance. It is refillable with a minimalist formula of carefully selected ingredients. The Valaya body cream delicately perfumes and hydrates the skin for 8 hours*. 

Massage the cream onto your body as part of your daily ritual.

*Instrumental test on 11 women.

title: Delina Refillable Body Cream
body: The Delina body cream leaves the skin scented with the floral accents of the Delina fragrance. With a captivating heart of rose, its smooth texture envelops the skin in a delicately perfumed veil. Delina is a sparkling scent that encompasses the softness and sensuality of what it is to be a woman due to a vibrant radiance and a stirring floral composition.

title: Feminine Discovery Selection
body:
Discover the Feminine Discovery Selection by Parfums de Marly, an elegant set featuring Delina, Valaya, and Palatine in 5ml formats accompanied by a sophisticated case designed to carry your signature scents wherever you go.

Three iconic signatures of the Maison, crafted to explore the richness of their trails and reveal your presence with confidence, femininity, and refined audacity.

title: Delina 5ml
Athénaïs
body: Athénaïs opens with sparkling notes of neroli and yuzu, followed by a luminous heart of orange blossom, settling on a warm and addictive tonka bean powdery base. Flamboyant, charming and vivacious.

title: Oriana
body: Oriana opens with sparkling mandarin and reveals a luminous heart of orange blossom and jasmine, settling into a gourmand base of marshmallow, praline and velvety musks. Gourmand, irresistible and delightful.

title: Valero
body: Valero Extrait de Parfum unveils a refined sensuality: subtle Bourbon geranium, elegant lavender, and sensual ambrox come together in an intensely sophisticated woody fougère signature. An ode to visionaries.

title: Eragon
body: Eragon Extrait de Parfum reveals an audacious olfactory signature where rich patchouli, vibrant cinnamon, and smooth vanilla blend into a deep, ambery, and spicy trail. The creative source.

body: The Maison invites you to experience an enchanting spectacle at the heart of the Château de Marly with this precious Masculine Discovery Collection, capturing all the magic of the Maison. From warmth to freshness, from florals to spices, the spirit of Marly is revealed through a selection of five emblematic masculine fragrances: Layton, Haltane, Althaïr, Perseus, and Castley.

title: Feminine Discovery Collection
body: The Maison invites you to experience an enchanting spectacle at the heart of the Château de Marly with this precious Feminine Discovery Collection, capturing all the magic of the Maison. body: The Collector’s Coffret is an olfactory journey through 18 of the Maison’s most iconic fragrances for men and women, presented in a 5ml format. Each scent unveils an audacious and distinctive signature. The set also includes a travel spray, ideal for extending the olfactory experience.

title: Carios

title: Travel Case
body:
Sophisticated and travel-ready, the 10 ml Travel Case combines practicality with refined design—crafted for those always on the move and ideal for keeping favourite fragrances close at hand, wherever the journey leads.

Conceived as a statement of style and identity, the Travel Case embodies a distinctive and instantly recognizable elegance. Carefully crafted, its textured and refined design reflects a sophisticated, free-spirited art of living. Practical and refillable in a 10 ml format—thanks to the Refill Sets and Discovery Collections—it is the perfect companion for every moment. Both a refined accessory and an expression of singularity, it carries fragrance with discretion while affirming a unique olfactory signature.

title: Feminine Discovery Set
body: The Parfums de Marly eau de parfum discovery set is a curated collection of splendid femininity. Discover the feminine range through a bespoke selection of seven 1.5ml scents. The set is the perfect olfactory curation, as it allows one to explore the best in traditional and modern perfumery. The feminine fragrances include the Maison's iconic fragrances: Valaya, Delina La Rosée, Delina, Oriana, Palatine, Valaya Exclusif and Delina Exclusif.

title: Delina La Rosée 5ml
Castley
body: Castley blends vibrant bergamot and ginger freshness with zesty Timut pepper, resting on a warm base of labdanum and akigalawood. Radiant, elegant and audacious.

title: Delina 30ml
body: Delina opens with juicy, sweet lychee, revealing a heart of Damascena rose and a trail of soft musks and cashmeran. Addictive, sensual and generous.

title: Valaya Exclusif 30ml
body: Valaya Exclusif opens with the purity of white flowers complimented by an enveloping almond with powdery notes. Elegant, sensual and alluring.

title: Valaya Exclusif
body: Valaya Exclusif opens with the purity of white flowers complimented by an enveloping almond with powdery notes. Elegant, sensual and alluring.

title: Haltane
body: Haltane opens with the aromatic freshness of bergamot and lavender, reveals a subtle gourmand praline heart, then intensifies into the depth of oud. Sophisticated, audacious and powerful.

title: Valaya Hair Perfume
body: The Valaya Hair Mist perfumes your hair with the delicate notes of the Valaya perfume. A radiant aura and yet, an impalpable softness. Fresh notes of bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach lead to a heart of orange flowers, settling on musk and woody base notes. Gently spray the light mist directly onto the hair or onto a hairbrush. Its small and handy format makes it easy to slip into a purse. The perfect accompaniment to the Valaya eau de parfum.

title: Valaya 30ml
body: Valaya evokes a veil of linen caressing the skin, with vibrant mandarin, creamy white flowers and rich akigalawood resting on a musky base. Elegant, delicate and sensual.

title: Valaya
body: Valaya evokes a veil of linen caressing the skin, with vibrant mandarin, creamy white flowers and rich akigalawood resting on a musky base. Elegant, delicate and sensual.

title: Delina Body Oil
body: In accompaniment to its emblematic fragrance, Parfums de Marly has created a Delina body oil. This light, non-greasy formula sublimates the skin, adorning it with notes of rose damascena, rhubarb, lychee and bergamot on a subtle base of cashmeran and musk. Depending on skin tone and season, it stirs the original notes and further modulates their seductive power. A sensual, multi-faceted delight.

title: Perseus
body: Perseus combines bright grapefruit, fresh geranium, and refined vetiver. Bright, invigorating and refined.

title: Oriana 30ml
body: Oriana opens with sparkling mandarin and reveals a luminous heart of orange blossom and jasmine, settling into a gourmand base of marshmallow, praline and velvety musks. Gourmand, irresistible and delightful.

title: Delina Exclusif 30ml
body: Delina Exclusif unveils fruity lychee and pear, melting into a sensual heart of Damascena rose, wrapped in soft musks and warm vanilla. Mysterious, intense and seductive.

title: Delina La Rosée 30ml
body: Delina La Rosée evokes fresh morning dew caressing rose petals, through an opening of vibrant lychee, revealing a heart of Damascena rose and a delicate flowers, settling on velvety white musks. Luminous, delicate and refreshing.

title: Althaïr
body: Althaïr combines the smoothness of vanilla, the indulgence of praline, and the brightness of orange blossom. Elegant, generous and charismatic.

title: Layton Exclusif
body: Layton Exclusif opens with the radiant freshness of bergamot blended with the enveloping softness of lavender, before settling into a base of sandalwood, oud and leather. Captivating, mysterious and intense.

title: Galloway
body: Galloway reveals bright, zesty notes of lemon blended with spicy freshness. It rests on a warm base of ambrox and musks. Elegant, pure and bright.

title: Percival
body: Percival combines the vibrancy of bergamot with the softness of lavender and the warm sensuality of tonka bean. Refreshing, bright and versatile.

title: Kalan
body: Kalan fuses zesty orange with black pepper notes and aromatic lavender, grounded by warm, radiant cedarwood. Fiery, luxurious and splendid.

title: Masculine Discovery Set
body: A curated collection of elegant masculinity. Discover and explore the Parfums de Marly masculine range of olfactory narratives through a bespoke selection of seven 1.5ml fragrances. Providing a unique scent for every occasion, day or night, the set features bold and subtle elegance via masculine eau de parfum including the Maison's iconic fragrances: Castley, Althaïr, Haltane, Layton, Pegasus, Percival and Oajan.

title: Delina Hair Perfume
body: The Delina Hair Perfume is a light mist to be sprayed directly onto the hair or onto a hairbrush. It has a poetic floral scent that will be swirling inside your mind long after it is applied. With a fragrant heart of rose, it has the perfect touch of modern femininity, which concludes at the base with cashmere wood essence that infuses the hair perfume with a velvety sensuality. The perfect accompaniment to the Delina eau de parfum.

title: Carlisle
body: Carlisle opens with the crisp freshness of apple blended with seductive nuances of tonka bean, before settling into a warm and deep patchouli base. Explosive, captivating and intense.

title: Layton
body: Layton blends the freshness of apple with calming lavender, wrapped in the earthy depth of patchouli. Elegant, sensual and flamboyant.

title: Sedley
body: Sedley combines the freshness of mint and citrus notes with the aromatic elegance of lavandin, resting on a woody sandalwood base. Fresh, vibrant and energizing.

title: Greenley
body: Greenley opens with green apple, reveals a noble petitgrain heart, then unfolds into a warm base of ambrox and amber woods. Fresh, lively and soothing.

title: Athalia
body: Athalia opens with a bold bitter orange, followed by a warm heart of iris and cashmeran, and settling into a rich base of musks and amber. Mysterious, enigmatic and captivating.

title: Godolphin
body: Godolphin highlights warm accents of saffron, reveals the power of noble leather, and unfolds into an intense amber base. Unnbound, vigorous and sophisticated.

title: Pegasus
body: Pegasus opens with radiant bergamot, softened by the smoothness of almond, and unfolds into a warm, captivating vanilla base. Vibrant, addictive and sensual.

title: Delina La Rosée
body: Delina La Rosée evokes fresh morning dew caressing rose petals, through an opening of vibrant lychee, revealing a heart of Damascena rose and a delicate flowers, settling on velvety white musks. Luminous, delicate and refreshing.

title: Safanad
body: Safanad radiates a warm and velvety allure, through the luminosity of bergamot, a heart of orange blossom and elegant jasmine, settling on ambrox, vanilla, and sandalwood. Charming, enveloping and warm.

title: Meliora
body: Meliora opens with a vibrant, playful burst of zesty raspberry, unfolding into a heart of elegant rose and ylang-ylang, and settling on a warm, woody vanilla base. Uplifting, delicate, and elegant.

title: Delina Exclusif
body: Delina Exclusif unveils fruity lychee and pear, melting into a sensual heart of Damascena rose, wrapped in soft musks and warm vanilla. Mysterious, intense and seductive.

title: Cassili
body: Cassili opens with a delightful burst of peach, unveiling vibrant accents of plum and mimosa, and settling into a comforting trail of creamy sandalwood and vanilla. Joyful, soft and lively.

title: Delina
body: Delina opens with juicy, sweet lychee, revealing a heart of Damascena rose and a trail of soft musks and cashmeran. Addictive, sensual and generous.
